shared_elements: registers or horizontal organisation of motifs
justification: Both surfaces reduce human presence to schematic repeated vertical strokes arranged in a row along a horizontal line, and both include a small quadruped in profile, but these are generic conventions. A shows a multi-register figural scene of standing robed figures with raised arms, headdresses and offering stands facing one another, while B shows a large boat hull with upturned prow terminating in an animal head and a crew of tally-like strokes — the central motifs and their relationships have nothing specific in common.
